Demonstrate ability to produce high quality radiographs with any type of equipment within department. Functions with confidence in surgery. Maintain a repeat rate below 5%. Submits quality images. i.e., optimal positioning, free of artifacts, optimal contrast timing.

Follow all radiation protection guidelines, as listed in Title 17, California Radiation Control Regulations. Comply with film badge policy 100% of the time. Shield patients per protocol 100% of the time. Record female patients LMP 100% of the time. Follow proper storage and upkeep of lead aprons and gloves 95% of the time. Follow appropriate protection protocols for other employees and/or family members in the radiology areas.

Room set-up and assist radiologist with supply control. Changes linen after each use. Cleans room as needed and keeps stocked. Is eager to and is proactive to insure scheduled exams begin on time or prior to appointment. Follow proper techniques for sterile procedures. Assists radiologist when indicated anticipating radiologists needs prior to and during procedures.

Monitor all equipment use and function. Reports all malfunctions of equipment to immediate Supervisor. Fills out appropriate paperwork, if indicated. Follows directions of appropriate person in repair or adjusting use of equipment.

Complete all patient paperwork. Collects and records accurate and complete patient history. Collects and records complete indications for exam with proper grammar and only using approved abbreviations. Expedites exams supporting documents, securing prior imaging and communicating the availability of this information to the radiologist. Reports all problems with exams to the appropriate person.

STAFF RESPONSIBILITIES: Actively supports the organization's mission, philosophy and strategic plan. Complies with safety, infection control, CHW Integrity Program, and other organizational policies. (annual evals. annual competencies completed). Complies with the organization's dress code. Demonstrates good time management and priority setting. Arrives at work on time, as demonstrated by no more than five (5) occurrences of tardiness in the prior 12 months. Attends work consistently, as demonstrated by no more than five (5) unscheduled absences in the prior 12 months.
